thread:
Alex: Heads-up 1: AcmeCloud HW listing readiness. Theyre asking about usage/metering contract for marketplace billing. Need a concise ingest/reconciliation contract and test plan.
Priya: I started a runbook in the shared sheet. Key callouts: timezone normalization to UTC, ingest TTL, SKU mapping, and PII constraints. Link: https://docs.reed.example/s/acme-hw-onboard
AcmeCloud PM: We can emit 15m batches. Sample record (we can send epoch ms): {"device_id":"dev-ACM-01","timestamp_ms":1712130000000,"usage_units":42,"sku_code":"acme-pro"}. We prefer sending unhashed serials initially but can hash if required.
Diego: Technical asks: include X-Idempotency-Key header; prefer device_id+timestamp_ms dedupe; accept epoch ms via header X-Event-Time-ms if multiple events per batch. API should return 202 + Location for async processing. We'll emit rate-limit headers.
Marta: For entitlements: partner_account_id must be provisioned to map to Redwood customer_id. We need partner to include partner_account_id in payload or header. Also specify whether usage is billable or diagnostic (is_billable boolean).
Priya: Add compliance note: legal wants hashed device identifiers (SHA256) or device token. TTL: default 24h ingest window; allow 72h backfills with ops approval and audit trail.
AcmeCloud PM: We'll switch to hashed ids. Good to know about 72h backfills. Also confirm dedupe key and idempotency behavior for retries.
Alex: Decision points: 1) Ingest contract: accept JSON lines batch POST to /partner-ingest/acme with headers X-Event-Time-ms, X-Idempotency-Key, Content-Type: application/x-ndjson. 2) Response: 202 + Location: /ingest/status/{batch_id}. 3) Default TTL 24h; 72h backfill by request. 4) Dedupe: device_id_hash + timestamp_ms. 5) Output: daily reconciliation CSV with aggregates by partner_account_id + marketplace_sku_id + hour.
Diego: I'll implement the consumer and add a schema in the repo. Example ingest request body (one line): {"device_id_hash":"sha256:abc123...","timestamp_ms":1712130000000,"usage_units":42,"partner_account_id":"acct-987","sku_code":"acme-pro","is_billable":true}. Response example: HTTP/1.1 202 Accepted
Location: /ingest/status/ba7ch-42
X-Received-Ts: 1738000001
X-RateLimit-Limit: 1000
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 998
I'll open a PR with schema + unit tests by EOD.
Priya: I'll own the reconciler SQL and golden-file comparison. For daily CSV: fields = [date_hour, partner_account_id, marketplace_sku_id, total_usage_units, billable_usage_units]. We'll provide the query and a sample golden file.
Marta: Legal/compliance will add the hashed-id requirement to the partner SLA and a short data retention note. Also need to capture consent for device telemetry in agreement.
AcmeCloud PM: We'll provide sku mapping table and golden file before the partner test. We can run a synthetic run Wed 10:00am PT with 15m batches and a load spike test.
WebhookBot: Reminder set: acme-onboard-test-1738000000 at 2026-04-08T17:00:00Z
Alex: Action items: (A) Diego: PR + consumer impl + rate-limits (eta EOD). (B) Priya: runbook, reconciliation query, golden-file template (eta Tue noon). (C) Marta: add compliance notes to onboarding checklist + backfill approval flow (eta Tue EOD). (D) AcmeCloud PM: deliver hashed sample payloads, sku mapping, and golden file before test. I'll schedule the partner dry-run and share runbook. :calendar:
